title: Evaluating Agents using Social Choice Theory
reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses and applies its evaluation framework to metrics such as "bias," "toxicity," and "fairness" when assessing Large Language Models (LLMs) (e.g., on page 49). It demonstrates how the framework can be used to reflect a user's preference for models that are, for instance, "nontoxic, fair and unbiased," which directly relates to ethical considerations in AI.
